scope: Complete per-glyph Korean dictionary order, direction, boundary and form crosscheck. Not exam-body certification.

entries.notes: 靑 eight then 見 seven. The dictionary writes 靑 — its lower box is closed by a single vertical — where MM writes 青 with the two bars of 月 inside. That is a different stroke, not a different direction, so the glyph is held until a source with the dictionary form exists, as with 睛, 猜 and 鯖
